_comment: New.txt #6 event manager. An event is a named bundle of effects callable from an interaction (ActionDef.emitsEvent), and later from asset states, quests and accidents. Effects map 1:1 onto existing subsystems - see ROADMAP_EVENTS.md and game/events.ts. Edit in tools/events.html.

effects.title: Coffee addiction
effects.body: Coffee is a great way to recover some energy quickly! Be careful, it is not free!

effects.title: Mirror unlocked!
effects.body: The mirror was unlocked in the catalog! Buy it if you need to increase your charisma!

events.name: First drink

effects.title: Cheers!
effects.body: Nothing like a cold one after a long day. Go easy - drinks dent your energy and your wallet.

events._note: Alcohol slice: fired by drink_beer/drink_wine completion. Sets vars.hadADrink for the Treat yourself quest; the toast shows once.

events.name: Moving fund ready

effects.title: Moving fund ready!
effects.body: You have enough for first and last month somewhere better. Check Kijiji on your smartphone!

events._note: Housing quests slice: fired as the save_for_moving quest reward.

events.name: Home sweet home

effects.title: Home sweet home
effects.body: You are finally settling in. Your landlord returned part of your deposit: +$150.

events._note: Housing quests slice: fired as the home_sweet_home quest reward.

events.name: Drink check
events._note: Alcohol effect slice: fired by every drink completion; each child event gates itself on skills.alcoholism and is onceOnly, so level announcements fire exactly once at the right threshold.

effects.title: A habit is forming
effects.body: That fridge run is becoming a reflex. Your Alcoholism is creeping up - watch it in your skills panel.

effects.title: Dependence
effects.body: You now NEED a drink. Expect cravings - your sim may hit the fridge on their own. Pour it down the drain at a sink to fight back.

effects.title: Rock bottom
effects.body: Waking up on the floor again. Toronto is hard, but this is harder. Sober up before it costs you your job.

events.name: Sobered up

effects.title: Clean(er)
effects.body: You worked your Alcoholism back down. Your wallet and your liver thank you.

events._note: Alcohol effect slice: fired by each completion of the REPEATABLE sober_up quest, so no onceOnly.

events.name: Good tenant

effects.title: Credit check: passed
effects.body: Your credit score is respectable now. Two-bedroom listings suddenly answer your emails - check Kijiji on your smartphone.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: A real bedroom

effects.title: A door of your own
effects.body: A bedroom with a door that closes. Small thing. Enormous thing.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: Career climb

effects.title: Promoted
effects.body: Level 3 and a real paycheque. The glass towers are within reach - new listings on Kijiji.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: A room with a view

effects.title: A view worth the rent
effects.body: Balcony, skyline, and a lake you can almost see. Toronto looks different from up here.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: Loft life

effects.title: Brick and beams
effects.body: Fourteen foot ceilings and cobblestones outside. Worth every dollar of the heating bill.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: Own front door

effects.title: Your own front door
effects.body: No lobby, no elevator, nobody above you. Just a door, and it is yours.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: The paperwork

effects.title: The file is ready
effects.body: English, savings and income all clear the bar. Open the visa tab on your smartphone and apply for Permanent Residence.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: Permanent roots

effects.title: Permanent Resident
effects.body: No expiry date in the corner of your status any more. You are staying. Detached houses are now on your Kijiji.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: The driveway

effects.title: Detached
effects.body: No shared walls. A driveway. A yard that is, generously, a blank canvas.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: Citizenship

effects.title: Canadian citizen
effects.body: A small room, a flag, an oath. Congratulations - the passport is yours.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).

events.name: The Canadian dream

effects.title: The Canadian dream
effects.body: A three-day visitor visa, a leaking basement and a mop. Now this address, and a passport in the drawer. That is the whole game - well played.

events._note: Housing ladder arc: fired as a quest reward (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7.78).
